output.sql: SELECT c.country AS country, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue_eur FROM marts.fct_orders o JOIN marts.dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue = true AND c.segment = 'enterprise' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY net_revenue_eur DESC;
output.explanation: Revenue is net_revenue from fct_orders restricted to is_revenue = true (completed orders), joined to dim_customers for the enterprise segment and country. Filtered to order_date in calendar 2025 (fiscal year equals calendar year), grouped by country, and sorted highest first. Shipping fees are excluded because net_revenue does not include them.
